title: R-0005 — Evidence-efficient, graph-complete governed review
summary: Extend the R-0004 deterministic compliance kernel with pre-routing graph-quality assessment, one bounded changed-symbol caller expansion, a single content-addressed evidence envelope with scoped lens views, exact selective dispatch, slot-authored provenance, canonical revisions, coarse review operations, artifact references, and absolute structural and comparable-token efficiency gates.

current_state.summary: The dirty implementation contains useful R-0004 evaluation instrumentation, native-driver scaffolding, derivation counters, selective-routing work, shared-context work, reports and dashboard rendering. It remains too chatty and costly; module-only impact can be sparse; shared storage can still cause every model to read the full body; result provenance and revision identity are not end-to-end; full artifacts are repeatedly emitted; and the measured PR-9464 run missed a caller-dependent Blocker until manual analysis. This design keeps the absolute compliance kernel and corrects those mechanics without a breadth=all fallback.

decision: Retain R-0004's host-neutral absolute-compliance state machine and bounded Claude/Codex adapters. Insert a deterministic graph-quality gate and at most one bounded caller expansion before routing; fail impact_incomplete with zero dispatch when confidence remains insufficient. Derive one immutable full envelope, deterministic per-slot scoped views, one complete 26-lens decision, exact deep plus one light-sweep dispatch, lease-bound lens-authored results, and one monotonic findings revision shared by report, dashboard and gate. Replace chatty review orchestration with review start/collect and compact artifact-reference manifests. Token comparisons occur only for fully compliant matching-key runs.

alternatives.name: Incremental quality-gated evidence kernel
alternatives.description: Extend the existing R-0004 kernel with a conditional graph-quality/evidence layer.

gains: Fail-closed graph completeness with bounded incremental cost
One canonical evidence and revision chain
Measurable selective model reads and dispatch
tradeoffs.revisit_when: Caller adapters cannot cover the repository languages within the declared bounds.

alternatives.name: Complete repository-wide language-server call graph on every run
alternatives.description: Index a complete caller graph before every review.

costs: Weak polyglot portability and server availability
tradeoffs.revisit_when: A persistent trusted index makes full refresh cheaper than bounded expansion.

alternatives.name: Per-lens retrieval and derivation
alternatives.description: Let every lens discover and retrieve its own evidence.

costs: Uncontrolled model reads and unverifiable routing
tradeoffs.revisit_when: Never for governed evidence; only non-gating exploratory analysis.

alternatives.name: Module graph plus one full shared prompt
alternatives.description: Keep module-only impact and give every lens the complete shared artifact.

costs: Every model still pays to read irrelevant evidence
tradeoffs.revisit_when: Only when the complete envelope is itself small enough to fit the bounded view policy.

alternatives.name: Transcript/model-judge compliance
alternatives.description: Infer workflow and quality from a transcript-scoring model.

costs: Cannot enforce ordering, provenance or immutable context
tradeoffs.revisit_when: Use only as secondary non-gating quality evidence after absolute checks.

contracts.description: R-0004 host-neutral normalized hook event and secret-safe bounded process boundary remain mandatory for all review/evaluator operations.
Graph-quality-complete RoutingInput maps all 26 lenses to deep/light/n-a; exact dispatch, mapper_unavailable, impact_incomplete, floors, and explicit --all/calibration modes are normative.

One content-addressed immutable full envelope plus deterministic scoped views binds target, diff, graph quality, full impact, runnability, requirement/acceptance, contracts, routing and fingerprints without lens re-derivation.
Coarse-operation budget, compact manifests, one-copy artifacts, structural counters, effective-token telemetry and strict comparison-key policy.
Lease-bound slot/lens authorship, target/context/view binding, canonical findings fingerprint and monotonic revision identity shared by findings/report/dashboard/gate.
A deep slot or single light-sweep slot receives a bounded scoped view and verified full-envelope reference; n-a receives no brief.
Freshness, scanner coverage, unresolved edges, truncation, module confidence, changed-symbol callers, one expansion attempt and sufficient/incomplete disposition.
Absolute workflow/compliance precedes structural and token comparison; host adapters share a canonical attempted-run and capability schema.
Bounded noninteractive Codex JSON transport with existing host auth, repository-local hooks, secret-scrubbed model shell, timeout and process-tree cancellation.
Bounded Claude print/stream transport with capability_unavailable, secret scrubbing, timeout and process-tree cancellation.

failure_modes.mode: Graph remains stale, truncated, unsupported or unresolved after its single caller expansion.
failure_modes.recovery: Return impact_incomplete, create no slots or briefs, dispatch zero and require graph/adapter repair.

failure_modes.detection: No valid complete 26-lens RoutingDecision is produced.
failure_modes.recovery: Return mapper_unavailable and dispatch zero; use module signals only for isolated component-cache failure with sufficient graph quality.

failure_modes.mode: Scoped view omits mandatory evidence or points outside its envelope.
failure_modes.detection: View schema, range, requirement/contract and floor validation fails before dispatch.
failure_modes.recovery: Deterministically rebuild from the same envelope or fail closed.

failure_modes.mode: Result is missing, copied, reconstructed, wrong-slot, reused or fingerprint-mismatched.
failure_modes.detection: Lease/path/hook/fingerprint and expected-slot equality validation fails.
failure_modes.recovery: Reject provenance, keep review incomplete and block collection/gate.

failure_modes.mode: Report, dashboard or gate cites stale or contradictory identity.
failure_modes.detection: Projection tuple differs from canonical current findings revision.
failure_modes.recovery: Do not advance revision; rerender only from canonical findings and block gate.

failure_modes.mode: Artifact path escapes, aliases, changes after validation or digest mismatches.
failure_modes.recovery: Reject path, cancel affected slots, retain prior revision and emit secret-safe diagnostics.

failure_modes.mode: Host CLI is unavailable, unauthenticated, times out or is cancelled.
failure_modes.recovery: Record named canonical state, scrub environment, terminate process tree, close leases and infer no compliance.

failure_modes.mode: Effective-token telemetry is absent or comparison key differs.
failure_modes.detection: Telemetry method is unavailable or any exact key field mismatches.
failure_modes.recovery: Return not_comparable while continuing absolute workflow and structural gates.

failure_modes.mode: Coarse operation crashes after writing projections.
failure_modes.detection: Atomic current-revision pointer was not advanced.
failure_modes.recovery: Rerun by content key, reuse verified artifacts and leave prior revision current until completion.

risks.risk: Language-specific caller adapters can disagree or be incomplete.
risks.mitigation: Use one protocol, explicit unsupported/unresolved states, fixed bounds, mutation corpora and fail-closed sufficiency; keep repository names out of production.

risks.risk: Scoped views can save storage yet still cause hidden full-envelope model reads.
risks.mitigation: Count prompt-view and indexed full-envelope read bytes separately; make views sufficient and audit on-demand reads.

risks.risk: Slot provenance could be overstated as cryptographic authorship.
risks.mitigation: Claim only lease/path/fingerprint/hook-observed provenance; validate unique active contracts and reject orchestrator reconstruction.

risks.risk: Coarse commands could hide work-action budget use.
risks.mitigation: Bundle only internal read-only control substeps; keep model work, writes and tool calls visible across agents.

risks.risk: Efficiency work could lower review depth or severity.
risks.mitigation: Make absolute compliance, PR-9464 Blocker, exact dispositions and architecture/security floors precede token eligibility.

signals: target and graph-quality state transitions with bounds and reasons
routing mode, all 26 dispositions and exact slot equality
CLI, emitted-byte, derivation, dispatch, prompt-read, artifact and effective-token counters
driver capability, timeout, cancellation and comparison status
alerts: Block gate and surface impact_incomplete, mapper_unavailable, provenance failure, revision contradiction, path violation or structural budget breach to the active review owner.
observability.redaction: Events and stdout exclude full hunks, full findings, HTML, credentials, raw environment and unbounded model output.

rollout.strategy: Shadow graph quality, envelope/views, provenance and counters first; enable exact selective dispatch in frozen evaluation; then enable standalone Review, Evaluate and final EM in that order only after unchanged R-0004, PR-9464, host-parity and efficiency gates pass; retain read-only legacy decoding for one release.
rollout.rollback: Disable review_kernel_v2 only before review start. In-flight v2 runs must collect with v2 or cancel; never translate them to v1. Preserve append-only revisions. If v1 violates a current correctness/efficiency floor, fail closed rather than breadth=all.

visualization.reason: The human must verify the quality gate, single expansion branch, envelope-to-scoped-view fan-out, exact dispatch, provenance collection and single canonical revision across all projections.

lens_evidence.evidence: Grounded in the R-0005 measured baseline, current implementation surfaces, R-0004 invariants and frozen PR-9464 miss. The selected approach is the smallest extension that makes sparse-graph uncertainty fail closed while reducing repeated derivation, over-dispatch, full-context model reads and duplicate rendering. Alternatives include full indexing, per-lens retrieval, module-only shared prompts and model-judge scoring. Bounds, floors, contracts, security, host parity, rollout, rollback and all sixteen exact executable mappings are explicit. Shared storage is not credited as token savings without scoped prompt-view measurements.
